_status: TEAM ASSUMPTIONS, NOT DATA. Used only when fewer than 8 trials with observed blinding are in the calibration corpus. Every number here is shown in the UI when it is used. Replace by fitting on the real corpus.
_rationale: Excess correct guessing u = 2*accuracy - 1. The 2026 systematic review of 112 psychedelic RCTs reports that psilocybin, LSD and ayahuasca studies frequently reported blinding failure above 90% and inert-placebo MDMA trials above 85%; that motivates a high u for inert placebo. Lower values for active/low-dose comparators are guesses with deliberately wide SDs.
_feasibility_note: Feasibility weights are subjective (0-1) and editable. Ranking = expected bias reduction x feasibility.
